{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Read the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Confirm the status column is clean and only contains 'completed' and 'refunded'
print(f"Unique values in 'status': {df['status'].unique()}")
print(f"Missing values in 'status': {df['status'].isnull().sum()}")

# Count completed orders directly
total_completed = df[df['status'] == 'completed'].shape[0]
print(f"Number of completed orders: {total_completed}")"}
